text: Two checks no longer fail CI for reasons outside the change (#824, #827). The dashboard's browser tests share one launcher that gives a headless browser three minutes and one more try, since a loaded runner took more than the hard minute each test allowed. CI's ratification check, which reads a ratifying comment for every lock and plan on every change, asks GitHub again, at most twice, when a read fails for a moment, as the watcher already does; a refusal and an answer that doesn't ratify stay final.
